name: Mithril
description: A mysterious metal that imbues Hero gear with extraordinary power. You will need Mithril to continue leveling up your hero gear. How much will you need? Mythril is used for Hero gear ascension. After your hero gear reaches level 100 and level 10 mastery forging you can spend 2 mythic gear to make it red. After its red you have to enhance it to level 19 and level 11 mastery forging . then you can make the first enhancement with mythril. It will cost 10 mithril and 3 mythic gear . The first enhancement will give you 20 percent attack or defense in expedition depening on which hero gear you decide to upgrade. After you upgrade your gear will be level 20 . You then have to bring it to level 39 and mastery forging level 12 to enhance it again with mythril. Upgarde will cost 5 mythic gear and 20 mithril . The next upgrade will either give you 7.5% hero health or lethality for exploration depending on which gear you chose. After your upgrade your gear will be level 40 and you have to bring it to level 59 and mastery forging level 13 to enhance it again with Mythril. The upgrade will cost 30 mithril and 5 mythic gear . Your upgrade will either give you 30 percent defense or attack depending on which gear you chose. After your upgrade your gear will be level 60 and you have to bring it to level 79 and mastery forging level 14 to enhance it again with mythril. Your upgrade will cost 40 mithril and 10 mythic gear . If you decide to upgrade it further with mythril your upgrade will give you either 15 % hero attack or defense for exploration. After your upgrade your gear will be level 80 . You have to again enhance it to level 99 and mastery forging level 15 to make your next upgrade with myhril. The upgrade will cost 50 mithril and 10 mythic gear . It will either give you 50 percent attack or defense for expedition . After your upgrade the gear will be level 100 and maxed out for mythril upgrades How to get Mithril? Mithril is one of the most expensive items in the game. You can get 3 Mithril each week in the Arena and Labyrinth shops. Prioritize obtaining this item over others. You can also obtain it through certain events that appear on your calendar. We recommend prioritizing obtaining Mithril through these events. There are packs available in the store where you can purchase 1 Mithril from 5,99€ and the following packs will scale in the usual way. Packages are reset weekly Tips: Everyone can follow their own strategy, but we recommend first upgrade the hero gear that each hero is designed for. Infantry will play a significant role in defense, so increasing their defense and health stats will be a priority. In the case of Markmen and Lancers, we recommend increasing lethality first. The order to carry out these increases, our recommendation is to start with the infantry, then markmen and finally lancers. Infantry: gauntlets, belt , Marksmen: goggles, boots , Lancer: goggles, boots

description: A special collectible badge commemorating Whiteout Survival's 1st anniversary and a year of journeying together through the blizzard.

name: 2nd Anniversary Badge
description: A badge commemorating the triumphant second anniversary of Whiteout Survival and glories yet to come.

name: 3rd Anniversary Badge
description: A badge forged in happy commemoration of Whiteout Survival's third anniversary and a symbol of civilization, hope, and uncommon honor.

name: Authority
description: Whenever Chiefs within the State claim Daily Mission Chests or gather resources, the President gains [Authority]. President Skills expend [Authority]. The President/Supreme President can register for State-enhancing skills.

name: Blazing Meteor Puzzle Piece
description: Use to complete the puzzle and get the [Blazing Meteor] Skin.

name: Chief Charm
description: Chief Charm unlocked at Furnace Lv.25.

name: Chief Rename Card
description: Used to change your Chief's name

name: Chief Stamina
description: Used for daily events like troops deployment. 1 Stamina is restored every 5 minutes. Obtain more via VIP shop, Ultra Value Monthly, Deal Hero Rally, Buy Packs or Buy with Gems. Notes : I don't recommend buying stamina using DIAMONDS or GEMS Additional info You can buy stamina can on VIP SHOP (unlock vip lv 2) with 100 gems for 1 can, you have 5 chances can

name: Coal
description: The coal will be used to improve your buildings, do research and train your troops. You can obtain it by gathering, in events or by purchasing it. In your bag you will be able to see your different packs of coal available.

name: Epic General Scene Fragment Pack
description: Use to obtain 5 Scene Fragments of random themes. Star Rating Probabilities ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10.000% ⭐⭐⭐ 20.000% ⭐⭐ 40.000% ⭐ 30.000%

name: Explosive Arrowhead
description: This item can be earned via Lighthouse Intel Missions. Arrows can then be used to improve the bear trap. There are 5 levels of improvement possible in the bear traps, to increase the damage done to the bear by up to 25%.

name: Frost Sphere Puzzle Piece
description: Use to complete the puzzle and get the [Frost Sphere] Skin.

name: Frost Star
description: The universal currency of the Tundra. Can be used to purchase packs.

name: Gems
description: Gems can be obtained in many different ways, via events, missions, beasts, pack purchases, and more. They will be used to purchase different items in shop, as well as in events such as the Wheel of Fortune and others.

name: General Accessory Construction Contract
description: Used to redeem blueprints that can upgrade the accessories on Daybreak Island.

name: General Master Fragment
description: Use to obtain 1 random themed Scene Fragments that you have not obtain at highest quality.

name: Gold key
description: Can be used to perform 1 epic recruitment to obtain Hero Shard, Hero, Manual, Hero XP, Speedup, RSS

name: Harbor of Hope Blueprint
description: Accessory Harbor of Hope will be unlocked on first acquisition , subsequent blueprints can upgrade it.

name: Iron
description: The iron will be used to improve your buildings, do research and train your troops. You can obtain it by gathering, in events or by purchasing it. In your bag you will be able to see your different packs of iron available.

name: Island Prosperity
description: The Prosperity Bonus of an decoration will only be beneficial to Island Prosperity when placed on the Daybreak Island. The bonus will be affected by the [Type Limit].
sources: Places a decoration on the Daybreak Island.
Upgrades a decoration on the Daybreak Island.

name: Life Essence
description: Crystallized from the energy of Tree of Life and can be used to upgrade or purchase decorations on Daybreak Island.

name: Loyalty
description: Used to Enlist Troops at the Enlistment Office.

name: Loyalty Tag
description: Loyalty that can be used to enlist troops.

name: Marvelous Tile: Reconstruct
description: Shuffles all tile position randomly.

name: Marvelous Tile: Remove
description: Move the three front-most tiles to the Storage Zone.

name: Marvelous Tile: Withdraw
description: Returns the last moved tile from the elimination zone to its original position.

name: Meat
description: The meat will be used to improve your buildings, do research and train your troops. You can obtain it by gathering, in events or by purchasing it. In your bag you will be able to see your different packs of meat available.

name: Mystery Badge
description: Mysterious Badge can be used for trding in the Mystery Shop. Obtained via Daily Mission or Buy Pack

name: Mythic General Decoration Component
description: Used to upgrade certain Mythic decorations.

name: Mythic General Scene Fragment Pack
description: Use to obtain 6 Scene Fragments of random themes. Star Rating Probabilities ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10.000% ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 30.000% ⭐⭐⭐ 30.000% ⭐⭐ 20.000% ⭐ 10.000%

name: Platinum Key
description: Can be used to perform 1 advanced recruitment to obtain Hero Shard, Hero, Manual, Hero XP, Speedup, RSS

name: Prestige Badge
description: Used to purchase items in Prestige Shop.

name: Rare General Scene Fragment Pack
description: Use to obtain 4 Scene Fragments of random themes. Star Rating Probabilities ⭐⭐⭐ 10.000% ⭐⭐ 40.000% ⭐ 50.000%

name: Shot Token
description: Used in the [Dead Shot] event.

name: Starry Lighthouse Blueprint
description: When you obtain this blueprint for the first time, Starry Lighthouse will be unlocked on Daybreak Island. Extra blueprints acquired subsequently can then be used to upgrade Starry Lighthouse.

name: Steel
description: Essential material for upgrading furniture and technology. Obtained from Exploration.

name: VIP Points
description: VIP Points upgrade your Benefits level. There are different amount of vip xp : 10 - 100 - 1.000 - 10.000.

name: VIP Time
description: Gives (24h, 7d, or 30d) of VIP Time. Activate to get VIP Benefits.

name: Warhymn Testament
description: A sigil of honor earned in the flames of battle, redeemable for items at the Icefire Warhymn League Shop, or to Predict matches of the same.

name: Wood
description: The wood will be used to improve your buildings, do research and train your troops. You can obtain it by gathering, in events or by purchasing it. In your bag you will be able to see your different packs of wood available.

name: Advanced Wild Mark
description: A stone imbued with a subtle touch of the wild, which can fully unleash a pet's potential. Used for pet refinement.

name: Common Wild Mark
description: A stone imbued with a subtle touch of the wild, which can stir a pet's instincts to some extent. Used for pet refinement.

name: Energizing potion
description: A rejuvenating potion. Can be used for pet advancement.

name: Pet Food
description: Nutrient-rich, great for leveling up your pet.

name: Strengthening Serum
description: Extracted from the mightiest creatures, Can be used for pet advancement.

name: Taming Manual
description: A manual with diligent beast taming notes that can be used for pet advancement.

name: Advanced Teleporter
description: This Teleport brings you to a place that you choose. If you don't have the item the teleportation will cost 4.000 Gems instead.

name: Alliance Teleporter
description: This Teleport will place you closest to where your R5 is located, no matter if they are in an Alliance Area or not. Keep that in mind when using the teleport if you want to move to your hive, as the alliance territory gives bonuses but only when your Furnace is placed on the alliance territory!

name: Random Teleporter
description: The Random Teleporter is quite self explanatory. It will send you to a random place on the map.
sources: Via the little arrow icon below your avatar image in the UI. You have some rechargeable random teleports in here as well. After use they recover over time.
Via Alliance Shop (Random content every day)
With some luck via the Normadic Shop

name: Territory Teleporter
description: This Teleport will place you close to your HQ. If your alliance already has built the Tundra HQ, it will chose that HQ.
